news.title: Garage Prime 2.0 is Live! 🚀
news.content: The massive v2.0 update is here! Experience Case Mix explorer, Treasure Vault checklists, on-device OCR, and side-by-side car spec comparison.

news.title: Full Desktop-Browser App 💻
